description: This file defines API route handlers for a task management system using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for user registration, login, user info retrieval, and CRUD operations for tasks, along with marking tasks as completed. It references several models, utility functions, and in-memory data storage.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Data model for creating a new user.

classes.name: TaskCreate
classes.description: Data model for creating a task.

classes.name: TaskList
classes.description: Container for a list of tasks.

methods.name: register(user_create: UserCreate)
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user.

methods.name: login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends())
methods.description: Endpoint for user authentication and token issuance.

methods.name: list_tasks(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: List tasks relevant to current user.

methods.name: get_task(task_id: int = Path(..., gt=0), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieve a specific task by ID.

methods.name: update_task(task_id: int, task: TaskUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
